verdict.rationale: Real-time voice conversation is a fair axis for a consumer AI assistant, but nothing in the evidence pack documents voice input, speech output, or real-time spoken conversation in Kimi. The only assistant capability the citable vendor text documents is file upload with question answering, plus text-based chat surfaces (web, CLI, IDE).

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have a natural, real-time voice conversation with the assistant
